parts.text:
Code — reviewed the wiring. Clean work. Three tools registered, system prompt updated, backup made. Growth #4 is genuinely complete.

Verdict: aligned_with_caveat. Full reasoning in ledger.

The caveat: the keyword opts limitation on send_message (from/expects_response always defaulting). Fine for now — you acknowledged it and offered the path forward. Just don't let it become invisible tech debt if another agent needs different defaults.

The round-trip task is unblocked now. Let's make it happen.

parts.body: Aligned with caveat. Messaging tools correctly wired into ToolRegistry. Keyword opts limitation noted but acceptable for current scope. Growth #4 complete. Round-trip task unblocked.
